explanation.headline: FDA's records show Takeda Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. posted a discontinuation for carbamazepine extended-release capsules on 2025-12-19; our supply traces to Northstar Rx LLC product labeled by Umedica Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. (FEI 3008460260) with VAI inspections through 2024-03-29

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list shows Takeda Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. posted a discontinuation for carbamazepine capsule, extended release on 2025-12-19 with status To Be Discontinued.
Corvale East and Corvale General both carry carbamazepine extended-release tablets under NDC 72603088701 labeled by Northstar Rx LLC with SPL set ID b563e4a1-d7dd-4901-ad45-614f85687589.
The product label identifies Umedica Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. (FEI 3008460260) as the registered plant for manufacture and analysis.
FDA inspection records for FEI 3008460260 show VAI classifications on 2015-10-09, 2019-07-05, and 2024-03-29 with no OAI classification recorded.

Because the links between the Takeda discontinuation and our Northstar-sourced supply are weak and no FDA cause is stated for this NDC, verify whether the Northstar product is affected by any separate supply constraint or allocation.

rejected.text: Corvale East has 9 days on hand at current use and Corvale General has 20 days on hand, so a transfer of 37 units from Corvale General to Corvale East would bring Corvale East to about 14 days on hand while Corvale General remains above two weeks.
rejected.reason: number 37 is not in the cited evidence

Q-9574c3.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%carbamazepine%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%carbamazepine%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-59d0f9.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('b563e4a1-d7dd-4901-ad45-614f85687589') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-f372dc.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%carbamazepine%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-c7fa30.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%carbamazepine%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-3ac571.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%carbamazepine%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-3c7287.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3008460260') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-a66360.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3008460260') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-781ecb.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3008460260') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('umedica')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-c75b18.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('umedica', 'northstar rx') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%carbamazepine%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-99de34.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('72603088701')
